name: antibes-holiday
title_zh: 把概念或参考图变成松弛手绘风黑白线稿
tagline_zh: 想要快速手绘线条感、叙事小场景、非均衡比例，却不想一笔一笔抠？给个概念或参考图，它直接给你松弛开放的线稿。
tagline_en: Need quick hand-drawn line energy or casual story scenes without drawing every stroke? Feed it a concept or.
desc_en: Create original relaxed black-pen graphics from concepts or visual references, including sparse illustrations, narrative scenes, animals, objects, abstract relationships, icons, and logo marks. why_zh: 不是描图，是重画：它把参考图拆成简笔、开放轮廓、选择性复描，保留手绘的“不齐”和“漂移”。
why_en: It redraws, not traces—reconstructing references into shorthand forms, open contours, and selective retracing, keeping the human.
limit_zh: 只产出黑白线稿，不上色、不填充、不渲染质感；输入需是清晰概念或视觉参考，抽象纯文字描述可能输出过于简略。
limit_en: Outputs black-pen line art only—no color, fill, or texture. Needs a clear concept or visual reference; pure abstract text may yield overly sparse.
